p: Moriah: Which is the mountain where Abraham was thought to have sacrificed his son, Ge 22:2.
measure was threescore cubits: According to the whole length of the temple,
breadth of the house: It contained as much as the breadth of the temple did, 1Ki 6:3.
hundred and twenty: From the foundation to the top: for in the book of the kings mention is made from the foundation to the first stage.
Parvaim: Some think it is Peru.
vail of blue: Which separated the temple from the most holy place.

thirty and five cubits high: Every one was eighteen cubits long, but the half cubit could not be seen, for it was hid in the roundness of the chapiter, and therefore he gives to every one only 17 and a half.
hundred pomegranates: For every pillar a hundred, read 1Ki 7:20.
